scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Translative covering densities of order n log n” (preprints/Translative-covering-densities-of-order-n-log-n-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 092 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2944d4b3135b4d79), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are absolute constants c > 0 and n0 such that, for every integer n ≥ n0, some centrally symmetric convex body Kn ⊂ Rn satisfies θT (Kn) > cn log n.
